title: Thomas Edison, the Inventor
text:
Thomas Edison was an inventor from the United States. He is famous for the light bulb. He worked in a large laboratory in New Jersey. Edison had more than a thousand patents.

Edison did not give up when his experiments failed. He tested many materials before he found a good one for the light bulb. Today, his ideas are still used in homes around the world.

options: In a large laboratory in New Jersey
In a ship on the ocean

questions.text: What did Edison do when his experiments failed?
Why did Edison test many materials for the light bulb?
options: He wanted to find one that worked well
He wanted to make the bulb very expensive
He did not know what a light bulb was
He wanted to destroy all his experiments

questions.text: What can you say about Edison's character, based on the passage?
options: He was lazy and gave up easily
He did not care about his work
He was afraid of new ideas

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates a new device or method
a room or building where scientific experiments are done
official rights that protect a new invention

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison był wynalazcą z Stanów Zjednoczonych. Jest znany dzięki żarówce. Pracował w dużym laboratorium w New Jersey. Edison miał ponad tysiąc patentów.

Edison się nie poddawał, gdy jego eksperymenty kończyły się niepowodzeniem. Przetestował wiele materiałów, zanim znalazł dobry do żarówki. Dziś jego pomysły są nadal używane w domach na całym świecie.
